title: Гости из Кореи и похищение невесты  (Guests from Korea and Bride Kidnapping)

scenes.title: Гости из Кореи и выбор Кати  (Guests from Korea and Katya's Choice)
scenes.summary: Korean guests arrive at the hotel while Katya admits to Nastya that she is torn between Denis and Nikita.

scenes.title: Особая говядина  (Special Beef)
scenes.summary: Nikita talks wedding plans with Katya, while a Korean guest asks Chef Barinov to cook a special cut of meat.

scenes.title: Подозрительное мясо  (Suspicious Meat)
scenes.summary: Senya tries to steal a piece of the Korean guests' meat, but Fedya convinces him it might be dog meat.

scenes.title: Проверка на собаке  (Testing on the Dog)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya claim the meat is dog meat because a stray dog refused it, but Chef Barinov scolds them and cooks it himself.

scenes.title: Национальное блюдо Гули  (Gulya's National Dish)
scenes.summary: Gulya treats Lyova and his mother to a traditional Kyrgyz horse-meat dish, but Lyova's mother calls it barbaric.

scenes.title: Особый чай у бара  (Special Tea at the Bar)
scenes.summary: Gulya leaves Lyova's apartment offended, while a Korean guest asks Kostya to brew a tiny pinch of special tea.

scenes.title: Список недостатков  (The List of Flaws)
scenes.summary: Nastya presents Katya with a written list comparing Denis's and Nikita's flaws to help her choose a husband.

scenes.title: Обед для персонала  (Staff Lunch)
scenes.summary: Lyova wears a Kyrgyz hat to work, and Senya and Fedya warn him that Chef Barinov cooked the suspicious Korean meat for lunch.

scenes.title: Странная секта  (A Strange Sect)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov realizes the meat is veal, but the cooks discover the Korean guests belong to a mysterious religious sect.

scenes.title: Обида Гули  (Gulya's Resentment)
scenes.summary: Gulya gives Lyova the cold shoulder in the hallway, and Ainura explains that Gulya is waiting for him to propose.

scenes.title: Обычай красть невесту  (The Custom of Stealing a Bride)
scenes.summary: Ainura tells Lyova about the Kyrgyz custom of bride kidnapping, while Denis and Nikita discover Katya's list of their flaws.

scenes.title: Каннибалы и пророчество  (Cannibals and the Prophecy)
scenes.summary: Katya denies writing the list of flaws, while Senya and Fedya terrify themselves reading about the Korean sect's prophecies.

scenes.title: Сделка с Тимуром  (The Deal with Timur)
scenes.summary: Timur agrees to kidnap Gulya from the laundry room for Lyova, but Gulya leaves right before the Korean prophet walks in.

scenes.title: Виски или чай  (Whiskey or Tea)
scenes.summary: Timur kidnaps the wrong person in a rug, while Nastya stops Kostya from bringing Katya whiskey and brews the Korean tea instead.

scenes.title: Ошибочка вышла  (A Little Mistake Happened)
scenes.summary: Nastya gives Katya the strong Korean tea on the roof, while Timur unrolls his rug at Lyova's apartment to reveal the Korean prophet.

scenes.title: Пропажа пророка  (The Disappearance of the Prophet)
scenes.summary: The Korean followers storm into the kitchen accusing the staff of kidnapping their leader, sparking a standoff.

scenes.title: Огненное возрождение  (Fiery Rebirth)
scenes.summary: A kitchen fire convinces the Korean guests that Chef Barinov is their reborn prophet, while the herbal tea makes Katya and Nastya hallucinate.

scenes.title: Свадебный сон Кати  (Katya's Wedding Dream)
scenes.summary: Hallucinating from the tea, Katya imagines her wedding to Nikita and Denis's dramatic objection.

scenes.title: Приказ великого пророка  (Order of the Great Prophet)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov sends the Korean sect back to their homeland and orders his kitchen staff to get back to work without a bonus.
